answer: Charge every new agent a refundable stake that only unlocks after it completes verified work, and publish its record on a public marble ledger anyone can audit. A lantern check at the wharf of entry compares each newcomer against known patterns: same device, same funding wallet, same behaviour. Clones must each post a fresh stake and build a fresh history, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes plus a thousand work records, while one honest agent pays once.
